pages.default.column:
One column

This text column lets you add content to your site. You can change its width by dragging its border left or right. You can also move it by dragging and dropping.
pages.default.content:
Build your page

  • You can enter any information you want here: click on a text box like this one to edit its content.​
  • Use the menu on the right of the app to drag and drop content into your page.

Navigate your page

  • The left-hand navigation will be filled in automatically as you add pages.​
  • You can publish or unpublish your page at any time while editing it to control its visibility.
